name: red-evidence-target-binding-store-and-command
title: Land the registered target-binding store and the owner-gated red_evidence_binding_set command
description: Second implementation leaf (W2b) of the trusted RED-evidence subsystem spec (docs/requirements/decisions/red-evidence-subsystem-spec.md, DONE on main; W2a foundation DONE). Add the per-story target-binding STORE — .lattice/story/actives/<id>/red-target-bindings.json (schema proofstory.red_target_bindings.v1) with exactly one binding per acceptanceTargetRef and a createdAt-STRIPPED three-field targetBindingDigest, plus a committed-tree reader that resolves a binding via git show from a commit ref rather than the live story directory — and land red_evidence_binding_set as the subsystem's FIRST mutating CLI command, owner-lease gated through the single cli-engine choke point and mutation-authority gated, with the §3.3 write-time expectedRedTargets membership gate. This story deliberately owns the COMPLETE command-wiring recipe on the cheapest lowest-semantics command so the four later high-semantics commands inherit a proven, mechanically-verified path.
